Messages.Author: noodleboy
Messages.Body:
Okay, so the new Marcus Vitel is Sabbat. Advancement rules say:

When merged, the vampire has the special abilities of both the base
and advanced cards. The rest of the base card is ignored (capacity,
Disciplines, etc.). The advancement card applies in full. Some merged
cards have an additional effect that only applies when the two cards
are merged. This effect is identified in the card text by a "merged"
icon.

I presume "the rest of the base card is ignored" rule includes Sect.
Therefore, if you advance Marcus, he becomes Sabbat, and can no longer
hold the title of Prince, since only Camarilla vamps can be princes.

So, by paying 4 transfers and 1 pool, you get the honour of having
your shiny new Marcus with POT getting the shite beat out of him by
every Brujah on the table, and him being "advanced" so he has an
ability he already had in his unadvanced form?

Am i correct, or have I missed something?

noodleboy

Messages.Author: noodleboy
Messages.Body:
"
> You have POT, but also have a Marcus wich grants +2 BLEED to each sabbat
> vampire you control if the meth you bleed controls a ready camarilla
> vampire. Which sounds great to me =)

Incorrect. By becoming Sabbat, Marcus lose his Prince title, and thus
the special ability being Prince gives him. If you advance him, he
gets the same special he had on his old version. Hence, by advancing
him, you lose his votes, his specials stay exactly the same as they
were on the CE version, he gets POT, but can be rushed by Brujah.

Losing two votes and making him a target for any brujah on the table
is not worth POT and turning him into a Sabbat Lasombra IMHO.

But, that's just me.

noodleboy

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
> whoaa... too bad. you have to play writ of acceptance and a praxis seizure
> to get the +2 bleed ;)

Since he can never be Sabbat and a prince at the same time, the +1 bleed
of his base version (which is only active when he's a prince) will never
be active at the same time as the +1 bleed of his advanced version (which
is only active when he's Sabbat).
